data.title: 埃塔 · 遗迹温泉的休整
data.description: 遗迹考察的间隙，埃塔在石壁旁的温泉里泡得昏昏欲睡。探险装晾在岩石上，水汽模糊了她的紫眸。她把浴巾往上提了提，决定把密纹的下半段……睡醒再解。
data.action: 泡在温泉里伸懒腰，浴巾微松，困意朦胧
data.lighting: golden dusk light through rising onsen steam
data.promptProse: Between decoding sessions, adult Eta soaks in a ruin-side hot spring at dusk, stretching sleepily in her towel as steam curls around the ancient stones.
data.animaCaption: The runes can wait until after her nap. Eta stretches in the steam — science resumes at dawn.
